high_level_overview.overview: This JCL job, named INTRDRJ1, serves as a trigger mechanism that first backs up a card demo FTP dataset before submitting a secondary job for execution. In its initial step, it uses IDCAMS to replicate the dataset AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST into a backup dataset (AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST.BKUP), ensuring data preservation before further processing. It then uses IEBGENER to read a stored JCL member (INTRDRJ2) and submit it directly to the internal reader, effectively chaining job execution in an automated, sequential workflow.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The JOB statement marks the beginning of a job and assigns the job name INTRDRJ1, which uniquely identifies this job to the system.

parameters.name: ACCT
parameters.description: The accounting information parameter used for job accounting and billing purposes, associating this job with the COBOL account.

parameters.name: PROGRAMMER
parameters.description: The programmer name or description field identifying the person or group responsible for the job, used for informational and output labeling purposes.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class A, which determines the job entry subsystem (JES) input queue where the job is placed, affecting scheduling priority and resource allocation.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class H for the job log and system messages, determining where the job's message output (JES job log) is routed after execution.

parameters.name: MSGLEVEL
parameters.description: Controls the level of messages printed in the job log. The first value 1 prints all JCL statements including those from procedures, and the second value 1 prints all system and operator messages regardless of job completion status.

parameters.name: REGION
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum amount of virtual storage (5 megabytes) available to all steps in the job, controlling memory allocation for the entire job execution.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies that a notification message is sent to the submitting user (resolved via the symbolic &SYSUID to the current user's TSO ID) upon job completion or failure.

job_details.purpose: Copies the contents of a source dataset to a backup dataset using the IDCAMS REPRO command. This serves as a backup operation before the subsequent job submission step.
job_details.inputs: IN: AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST (source dataset); SYSIN: REPRO command

job_details.purpose: Reads a JCL member from a partitioned dataset and submits it to the internal reader, which causes the JCL member INTRDRJ2 to be submitted as a new job for execution.
job_details.inputs: SYSUT1: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.JCL(INTRDRJ2) (JCL member to be submitted)
job_details.outputs: SYSUT2: SYSOUT=(A,INTRDR) with DCB=(LRECL=80,BLKSIZE=80) — submits INTRDRJ2 as a new job via internal reader; SYSPRINT (utility messages)

data_operations.description: IDCAMS REPRO reads from input dataset AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST via IFILE(IN) DD statement
IDCAMS REPRO writes/copies records to output dataset AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST.BKUP via OFILE(OUT) DD statement
IEBGENER reads the JCL member AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.JCL(INTRDRJ2) from SYSUT1 as the source input
IEBGENER copies the JCL member to the internal reader (INTRDR) via SYSUT2, which submits the contents of INTRDRJ2 as a new job
